notes: Ἄρειον Πάγον is one unit for the single English 'Areopagus', headed on the noun (rules 35, 94).

The verbless clause's supplied 'is' goes to the interrogative predicate τίς and not to the noun subject 'teaching' (rule 63); both attributive articles are unrepresented, one displaced by 'this' and the other leaving its relativizer to the participle (rules 31, 38).
